title: Dutch Beer Cheese Wrap
description: A savory, Japanese-inspired snack using a Dutch beer-steeped cheese wrapped in a crispy tortilla.

ingredients.name: Beer-steeped Dutch cheese
ingredients.notes: steep 1 cup Dutch beer in 8 oz cheese for 30 minutes

instructions: Steep the beer in the cheese for 30 minutes.
Slice the cucumber into thin strips.
Place 2 oz of the beer-steeped cheese onto the Japanese wrap.
Add cucumber slices on top of the cheese.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
